messages:
anya: Weird onboarding hit: Python sample's toolcall helper in "json mode" returns a bytes-like object when the tool returns a small binary payload. Our schema validator expects dict/list and blows up.

bryce: Can you paste the minimal repro? I haven't seen bytes before in json mode.

anya: Repro (python sample):
```
# using sdk.json_mode(...) wrapper
resp = client.call_tool('summarize_blob', {'blob': blob_data})
# expected: {'summary': '...'} (dict)
# actual: b"{\"summary\": \"text...\"}" (bytes)
```

lina: Huh. That smells like a serialization inconsistency on the retry codepath. If auth refresh happens we might be re-wrapping the body without decoding.

tejas: I dug in: main path decodes to str then json.loads, retry path returns response.content (bytes) without the same helper pipeline. So you get bytes instead of parsed object.

anya: Onboarding impact: new users run the sample app, the eval harness fails at schema.validate, they file tickets thinking model output changed. We've had three tickets this week.

bryce: Short-term: add a README troubleshooting note and a one-line guard in the sample that normalizes bytes -> str -> json for the SDK output. Long-term we should guarantee "normalized native type" from all SDK helpers.

lina: Agreed. Proposal: SDK contract doc: 
- helper returns native types (dict, list, str, int, float, bool, None)
- never returns raw bytes or JSON strings for structured outputs
- parity across languages and retry/auth flows
We should add this as a short spec in devex docs.

tejas: I'll open a small patch in python-sdk to run the same parse pipeline on retries and add unit tests that simulate a 401 + refresh.

anya: Also can we include a schema-compatibility smoke test in sample CI that runs the sample app with a stubbed refresh server? That would have caught this.

bryce: Yep, add a job under devex/sample-smoke. It should run both py and node sample repros.

tejas: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/227 — fixes retry decoding + adds tests.

lina: Nice. I pushed a small README patch to the sample repo with the workaround and a repro script:
```
# run repro that forces refresh
REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN=expired python sample/repro.py
```

anya: Devex-bot: can you create an issue so support can track outstanding tickets and link PRs?

devex-bot: Created issue #1501: "sdk: json-mode helper returns bytes on retry (python sample onboarding)" — https://issues.redwood.ai/1501

bryce: Please add a changelog entry to both SDKs noting the guarantee and the regression protection label. Also add a short example table in the SDK README showing input -> expected helper output types.

tejas: Will do. Also adding a small note for embed/streaming edge cases where binary payloads might legitimately be bytes and the helper will return bytes only for non-JSON flows. We should document that exception.

anya: Once PR merges, ping support and add a one-line onboarding checklist item: "Run sample repro with expired token to validate SDK normalization". That should reduce noise.

lina: LGTM. After merge I'll flip the sample CI job to required.

tejas: Merged and backfilled tests, CI smoke job added under devex/sample-smoke.

devex-bot: Linked issue #1501 to PR #227 and added label "regression-protected".

anya: Great work team. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :party_parrot:
